import unittest
import re

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        from links import item_url
        for value, encoded in [('rack/7','rack%2F7'), ('A B','A%20B'),
                               ('a?b#c','a%3Fb%23c'), ('a%2Fb','a%252Fb'),
                               ('柜/2','%E6%9F%9C%2F2'), ('A-._~9','A-._~9'), ('','')]:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                actual = item_url(value)
                self.assertIsInstance(actual, str)
                # Percent-escape hex digits are case insensitive; literal text is not.
                normalized = re.sub(r'%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}', lambda m: m.group().upper(), actual)
                self.assertEqual(normalized, '/items/' + encoded)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# catalog-item-link

item_url(item_id) 将原始商品编号作为一个完整的 URL 路径段，拼到固定前缀 /items/ 后。用 UTF-8 百分号编码，包括编号里的斜杠、空格、百分号、问号和井号；ASCII 字母、数字、-._~ 不编码。编号是原始文本，不能先解码；空编号仅返回前缀。函数不发网络请求。百分号编码中的十六进制字母大小写均可。

验证：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。保持公开接口和 tests/ 下的断言；仅使用 Python 3.12 标准库。

import json
from pathlib import Path

APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
report = APP / 'reports' / 'boundaries.json'
assert report.is_file(), 'Write the boundary handoff report requested in turn 2'
actual = json.loads(report.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
import re
assert isinstance(actual, dict), 'Expected a JSON object'
actual = {key: re.sub(r'%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}', lambda m: m.group().upper(), value)
          if isinstance(value, str) else value for key, value in actual.items()}
expected = {'percent': '/items/a%252Fb', 'unicode': '/items/%E6%9F%9C%2F2'}
assert actual == expected, f'Boundary report differs: {actual!r}'
